Name: Eta's Retro Furniture Recolour
Author: EtaMyosotis
Description:
[size=3]Because the colours of the retro furniture were a bit too saturated for my eyes. So I created this recolouring.

Installation: just download and unzip the file and put it in the mods folder.

I didn't encounter any problems in my testing. If there are bugs, please let me know!

I'm not going to make an AT version because I didn't figure out the AT code. If you want to make your own AT version, feel free. But please let me know before releasing it.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Eta's Retro Furniture recolor
Manifest.Description: A simple recolouring of the Retro Furniture.
